evals.prompt: 帮我为当前项目创建一个AGENTS.md文件
evals.expected_output: An AGENTS.md file that analyzes the current project, detects its tech stack, and generates a complete AGENTS.md with all six core sections: Dev Environment Tips, Build & Test, Project Structure, Code Style & Conventions, Boundaries, and PR/Commit Guidelines. The file should be under 200 lines, use exact commands in backticks, and include the three-tier boundary system.

evals.prompt: I have a TypeScript monorepo with pnpm and Turborepo. It has a Next.js frontend in apps/web and a NestJS backend in apps/api, plus shared packages. Can you create an AGENTS.md for it?
evals.expected_output: An AGENTS.md file tailored for a TypeScript monorepo that includes monorepo navigation section, package-specific command targeting with --filter, project structure covering apps/ and packages/ directories, TypeScript-specific code style conventions, and appropriate boundaries for monorepo scenarios (e.g., asking before changing shared package APIs).

evals.prompt: My Python project already has an AGENTS.md but I think it's not great. Can you review and improve it? It's in the root of my project.
evals.expected_output: A review of the existing AGENTS.md against best practices, identifying missing sections (especially Boundaries), vague commands that need precision, content that should be linked rather than inlined, and suggestions for improvement. The output should be an improved version of the AGENTS.md rather than a complete rewrite.
